Chat request with tool_choice set to required forces the model to call a tool

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _request = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"What is the weather today?\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"tool_choice\":\"required\",\"tools\":[{\"function\":{\"description\":\"Get the current weather for a given location\",\"name\":\"get_weather\",\"parameters\":{\"properties\":{\"location\":{\"description\":\"The city name\",\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"location\"],\"type\":\"object\"}},\"type\":\"function\"}]}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chat(request: _request)
debugPrint(result.choices())
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].message().toolCalls() as Any)
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].message().toolCalls()?[0].function().name() as Any)
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].finishReason() as Any)
```
